scripts.setup: cp secrets.env.example secrets.env && npm run vault:sync
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,PORTAL" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow" "npm run dev -w uniz-production-gateway" "npm run dev -w uniz-auth-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-user-service" "npm run dev -w uniz"
scripts.sync:host: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,USER,PORTAL" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow" "npm run dev -w uniz-production-gateway" "npm run dev -w uniz-auth-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-user-service" "npm run sync -w uniz"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "CORE,ACADEMICS,OUTPASS,FILES,NOTIFY,MAIL,DOCS" -c "reset,green,cyan,white,yellow,magenta,blue" "npm run dev" "npm run dev -w uniz-academics-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-outpass-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-files-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-notification-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-mail-service" "npm run dev -w uniz-docs-service"
scripts.seed:local: ts-node scripts/seed-local.ts && cd apps/uniz-academics && DATABASE_URL='postgresql://user:password@127.0.0.1:5432/uniz_db?sslmode=disable&schema=uniz_academics&connection_limit=10' ts-node prisma/safe_seed.ts
scripts.watch: ssh -t -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no root@${VPS_HOST:-76.13.241.174} "watch -n 1 'kubectl get hpa; echo; kubectl get pods'"
